items.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh AI Demand
items.summary: The blended fair value estimate for Dell Technologies has shifted from US$594.16 to US$578.88, which signals a slightly more conservative central case in the current model. This adjustment sits against a backdrop of Street research that ranges from price targets in the low US$400s to the mid US$700s, reflecting both confidence in AI related demand and caution about how much is already priced in.
